meta.title: Valuation & Capital-Markets Context
meta.integrity_note: IMPORTANT. There is NO official government publisher of single-tenant net-lease capitalisation rates. Cap-rate data is sold by private brokerages and research firms. Per the verification policy, no cap rate is stated as a fact anywhere on this site. Cap rate appears only as an explicitly labelled SCENARIO INPUT on the Projection page, and every such row is flagged UNVERIFIED. The risk-free anchor below is official U.S. Treasury data read directly from home.treasury.gov.
